decisions.reason: Operator training was presented on its own page for two years and supports machine sales at little cost, so it probably meets aspirations and needs no problemistic search.
The fourth rotary axis accessory was only mentioned on the website and its results are uncertain, but it complements the core milling machines cheaply, so it can be carried rather than dropped.

Hybrid additive post-processing lies further from the core business, got only a mention, and after the 2020-2021 downturn reduced slack, a likely shortfall against aspirations makes it the first candidate to cut so resources can go back to core machines.
The high-speed CNC milling machine is a core product with its own page, and it represents a large investment central to the firm's established business.
The automatic tool change system had its own page and is closely tied to the machine portfolio, so it likely stays in line with aspirations.
